title: Public Law 119-85: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule…
summary: H.J.Res. 140, "Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Bureau of Land Management relating to Public Land Order No. 7917 for Withdrawal of Federal Lands; Cook, Lake, and Saint Louis Counties, MN.", originated in the House of the 119th Congress and became Public Law 119-85 on 2026-04-27, according to Congress.gov.
